text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The Arima is at Nakayama Racecourse...
...s-spe...cial...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Special... delete the "cial."
Um, Nakayama, racecourse's spe...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There it is! "Tokucho"!
Huh~, so that's read as "tokucho"~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... man, am I seriously that dumb? For real, though...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...If I could properly understand your strategies,
I wonder if I could get even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Things went well in the Copa Republica Argentina too.
I can do this. I can totally do this...!"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Let's put our all into cheering for Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Ohoooâ

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Damn. What is with them?
They're hyping each other up like crazy."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Can't let anyone see me looking so lame.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll give it my all~☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know. I did plenty of prep work, yeah?
Besides, you saw how I ran last time, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —'Cause I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the dream race held at Nakayama at year's end.
Who will claim the Grand Prix crown this year?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...I mean, it might actually be possible,
right? Real talk, I've already made it this far!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tap, tap, tap...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—This year, Umamusume worthy of the title "the strongest"
have announced their entry one after another. The packed crowd
is waiting with bated breath for the start!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tap, tap, tap...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, it looks like they'll be
entering the paddock shortly!
Everyone, please give them a warm welcome!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Jordan, keep it up!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
! Oh, I see ya.
Keep the chants comin'~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...Come to think of it, the Satsuki Sho is a GⅠ too, right?
Plus, I've already faced off against Seniors, so—)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here they come! They've arrived!
The Umamusume defining the golden era have taken the stage!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...!?
My ears, ouch...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unrivaled in the mile. Show us another miracle,
our 'Entertainer,' Fuji Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Staking everything on the pride of her bloodline, a beautiful flower blooms in glory!
Air Groove makes her appearance as well.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Please get out of the gate cleanly this year.
Will this be the one to defeat that Umamusume?!
Zenno Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What's that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. "Umamusume to Watch at the Arima Kinen!" ...huh.
The photo's huge, hilarious. So...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that Air Groove-san~?
Fuji-san's there too.
Also, Rob Roy-chan's racing outfit is super cute~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, honestly, I've seen all of them before.
Well, we go to the same school, so obviously."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: If anything, I've watched your practices way more than this reporter has. *sigh*... Magazines really exaggerate things sometimes, don't they...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...That's not it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're totally different from usual.
You've got an aura... going on.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Will it be a journey toward a dream, or an uncharted, breathtaking vista?
In whose hands will the title of current strongest Umamusume lie?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Here come Mejiro McQueen and Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooah!!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...She looks totally strong.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...I don't get it.
Why the heck are my legs shaking?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know, I don't know.
I don't know, I don't know, I don't know...!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've got no choice but to do it...!!
I wanna win, damn it...!
